title: x86-64 machine code opcodes
description: Real format: x86-64 instruction bytes — NOP (0x90), RET (0xC3), and the MOV/PUSH/CALL vocabulary.

title: ASCII and UTF-8 text encoding
description: Real format: text as binary — ASCII's 7-bit code and UTF-8's variable-length multibyte sequences.

title: ELF executable header
description: Real format: the ELF magic — 7F 45 4C 46 — and the header fields every Linux program carries.

title: JVM bytecode
description: Real format: Java bytecode — iconst, bipush, iadd — the stack-machine sequences of the JVM.

title: RISC-V opcodes
description: Real format: RISC-V's fixed 32-bit instructions — decoding an ADDI from its bit fields.

title: WebAssembly binary format
description: Real format: WASM's magic (00 61 73 6D), version, and section sequences — the web's bytecode.

title: IPv4 packet header bits
description: Real format: the 20-byte IPv4 header — version, IHL, TTL, and addresses as bit sequences.

title: CRC error detection
description: Real format: checksums and CRCs — the binary sequences that catch transmission errors.
